sentences.text: Errolosteus was an extinct member of the buchanosteid arthrodire placoderm, a group within the class Placodermi and the parent group Arthrodira.
This species is distinguished from others by its short and broad skull.
The holotype specimen ANU 21806 — the specimen the species is based on — was described alongside its relative Arenipiscis.
Fossils of Errolosteus have been found in Emsian-aged marine rocks in New South Wales, Australia. It lived between 410.62 and 393.47 million years ago during the Emsian stage.
